description: Wearing an elytra: jump looking straight down and throw a wind charge at the floor near the top of the jump: the explosion's knockback (the server's explode packet) launches the player, who presses jump in the air to glide east and lands. Then the same without gliding.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a armor.chest with minecraft:elytra
item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:wind_charge 16
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
